description: Ship Step 9: dev commit blocked by pre-commit hook
remediation: Ship workflow Steps 9/10/Close should commit via a temp branch (`docs/ship-{FID}`) created from dev in a new temp worktree, commit there (branch != dev/main → hook allows), then FF-merge dev from REPO_ROOT. Or: add a hook exception for commit messages matching `[skip ci]`.

recovery: Removed the forbidden token (replaced "app-gether-life" with "seed repo" in the comment). Fix committed and pushed clean.

description: Post-merge dev CI red: Payload migrate over Supabase IPv6
remediation: Any GitHub-Actions step that opens a _direct_ socket to Supabase Postgres must use the IPv4 **session** pooler (`aws-1-<region>.pooler.supabase.com:5432`, user `postgres.<ref>`), not the direct host. Transaction pooler (6543) can't run DDL. The Supabase CLI (`db push`) is unaffected — it uses the Management API.
recovery: Rewrote the step to fetch the pooler `db_host` from the Management API (region-agnostic) and rebuild `DATABASE_URL` as the session-pooler URL before `payload migrate`. Validated by a `[force build]` dev run.

remediation: Plan/design step should grep for pre-existing `forbidden-tokens.test.ts` SCAN_DIR + token policies before introducing a new brand/source-type literal into a scanned dir. Part-1 verify (and any verify touching `packages/services/src/corpus` or `packages/ai`) should run the AI-package `forbidden-tokens.test.ts` gate, not only typecheck + co-located unit tests.
recovery: Operator decision (AskUserQuestion): UPDATE the gate — drop `fcte` from `FORBIDDEN_SOURCE_ONLY_TOKENS` (legitimate DB-CHECK-enforced corpus source_type, not brand leakage) and remove the `"fc"+"te"` obfuscation so code/tests use the plain literal. To be captured in Part 3 Task 13 ADR + `docs/sync-with-gether.md` § Deviation.

description: Branch push blocked: lint-staged prettier --write disagrees with pre-push prettier --check
remediation: Plan/design/build close + summary steps that push a branch should run `pnpm format:check` (or a `prettier --write` over `docs/plans/{YYYYMM}/logs/{FID}/`) BEFORE `git push`, not rely on per-commit lint-staged. Alternatively make lint-staged + format:check share one resolved prettier invocation so `--write` is guaranteed to satisfy `--check`.
recovery: `npx prettier --write` on the two flagged files → `pnpm format:check` clean → committed `chore(203-...): prettier-fix plan docs` → push succeeded.

description: Build plan-1 spike blocked — opencode not installed
recovery: Install opencode (`npm i -g opencode` or equivalent), start a provider (Ollama with model pulled, or set NVIDIA_API_KEY), check both Gate 1 human-confirmation boxes in `plan-1.md`, then re-run the build workflow.

description: Build WS-7 mirror render — `pnpm bkit install` silently flips opencodeProvider + `--opencode` scopes install
remediation: WS-7 mirror re-render in bkit-repo builds must pin the provider AND select all hosts: `pnpm bkit install --claude --cursor --opencode=<committed bkit.opencodeProvider>`. Better: make install preserve an existing `package.json` `bkit.opencodeProvider` (read-existing-then-default) so a plain dogfood install is idempotent on the provider.
recovery: Reverted the flip (`git checkout HEAD -- package.json .opencode/opencode.json .bkit/version`), then full-host re-render with the committed provider: `pnpm bkit install --claude --cursor --opencode=nvidia`. Verified `.opencode/agents` 0-diff, provider `nvidia`, all 6 command mirrors carry the gate + NOTE, `pnpm bkit check` exit 0.

description: bkit-design.md Step 10.4 STRAY guard allowlists only `docs/plans/` + `.bkit/friction.md`, but the design phase legitimately appends sanctioned deferral rows to `docs/deferrals.jsonl` (per rules.md Never-drop) and friction to `.bkit/friction.jsonl`; the squash-merge to dev therefore trips the guard on `docs/deferrals.jsonl`, and the allowlist references a stale `.bkit/friction.md` (wrong extension).
recovery: Extended the Step 10.4 STRAY allowlist to also permit `docs/deferrals.jsonl` and `.bkit/friction.jsonl` for this run (intent-preserving: both are sanctioned append-only ledgers the workflow itself writes). Durable fix: update bkit-design.md (+ bkit-plan.md, which shares the pattern) STRAY regex to `^docs/plans/|^docs/(deferrals|failures|knowledge|decisions)\.jsonl$|^\.bkit/friction\.jsonl$`.
